note: S5.4 eval: 30 fixed ideas, as a non-technical person would type them. kinds: plain (no helper needed), helper (uses a helper live on the network), web (reads public pages), edit (built, then changed by a second message). A pass is reaching ready with a test answer.
followUp: Use your best judgement and build it now, please.

ideas.message: Suggest three short, friendly names for a small business from a one-line description.
Turn my rough notes into a polite, short email to a customer.
Explain a confusing sentence from a contract in plain English.
Give me a simple 3-day meal plan from the ingredients I list.
Rewrite a product description so it is shorter and clearer.
Check a short text for spelling and grammar mistakes and list the fixes.
Turn a list of tasks into a prioritised to-do list for today.
Write a friendly reply to a customer complaint I paste in.
Summarise meeting notes into decisions and next steps.
Translate a short message into Spanish and French.
Tell me if a crypto wallet address looks risky before I pay it.
Check a new supplier before I pay them: the company and their payment address.
Screen an Ethereum address and explain the result in two lines.
Before I send money to a wallet, give me a pay or do not pay verdict.
Do a quick due diligence report on a supplier from its name and wallet.
Check whether a UK company exists and who runs it.
Look up a company by its LEI and list any red flags.
Screen a list of up to three wallet addresses and rank them by risk.
Vet a new crypto counterparty: company, owners and wallet risk, short answer.
Tell me if a payment address on Base is safe, in one sentence.
Summarise any web page I send you in five bullet points.
Read a product page and tell me the price and the main features.
Read a news article link and tell me the three key facts.
Read a company's About page and describe what they do in two sentences.
Check a public web page and tell me when it was last updated, if it says.
Write a short, warm thank-you note to a customer from their name and what they bought.
ideas.edit: Make it sign off with 'The Team at Brightside'.

ideas.message: Turn a recipe into a shopping list grouped by aisle.
ideas.edit: Also add a rough total cost estimate at the end.

ideas.message: Summarise meeting notes into decisions and next steps.
ideas.edit: Put an owner's name next to each next step when the notes say who.

ideas.message: Tell me if a crypto wallet address looks risky before I pay it.
Suggest three names for a podcast from its topic.
ideas.edit: Also let it read a web page about the topic if I send a link.
